qualityAttributes.name: Availability
qualityAttributes.definition: Readiness for correct service when required.

qualityAttributes.name: Performance
qualityAttributes.definition: Timeliness and resource efficiency.

qualityAttributes.name: Scalability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to sustain increased demand by adding resources.

qualityAttributes.name: Elasticity
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to adapt resources rapidly to changing load.

qualityAttributes.name: Reliability
qualityAttributes.definition: Continuity of correct service over time.

qualityAttributes.name: Resilience
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to resist and recover from disruption.

qualityAttributes.name: Consistency
qualityAttributes.definition: Required guarantees across data observations.

qualityAttributes.name: Security
qualityAttributes.definition: Protection of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

qualityAttributes.name: Privacy
qualityAttributes.definition: Appropriate handling of personal/sensitive data.

qualityAttributes.name: Modifiability
qualityAttributes.definition: Cost and speed of implementing change.

qualityAttributes.name: Deployability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to release safely and independently.

qualityAttributes.name: Testability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ease of controlling and observing behavior.

qualityAttributes.name: Observability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to infer internal state from outputs.

qualityAttributes.name: Interoperability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to exchange and use information.

qualityAttributes.name: Portability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ease of moving across environments/platforms.

qualityAttributes.name: Recoverability
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to restore service and data.

qualityAttributes.name: Cost Efficiency
qualityAttributes.definition: Value relative to build and operating cost.

qualityAttributes.name: Simplicity
qualityAttributes.definition: Ease of understanding and operation.

qualityAttributes.name: Delivery Speed
qualityAttributes.definition: Ability to deliver valuable change rapidly.

qualityAttributes.name: Sustainability
qualityAttributes.definition: Resource and environmental efficiency.

rulePacks.name: Enterprise Architecture Baseline
rulePacks.description: Default governance checks for security, resilience, traceability and recorded decisions.

rules.title: Public boundaries require identity control
rules.description: A public deployable must be accompanied by an explicit control.
rules.rationale: Public application boundaries require modeled authentication and authorization responsibilities.
mitigations: Add an identity or access-control component.
Document a formally accepted exception.

rules.title: Technology data stores must declare encryption
rules.description: Physical data stores must explicitly declare encryption at rest.
rules.rationale: Security controls should be explicit and testable in the architecture model.
mitigations: Set encryptedAtRest to true.
Select a managed product that supplies equivalent controls.

rules.title: Critical deployment components span failure domains
rules.description: Critical physical components must use at least two availability zones.
rules.rationale: Critical services should not depend on one failure domain.
mitigations: Deploy across at least two zones or sites.
Document compensating recovery controls.

rules.title: Recovery strategy must be recorded
rules.description: A formal recovery architecture decision is required for governed designs.
rules.rationale: Recovery objectives and ownership should be explicit before approval.
mitigations: Record an ADR covering backup, failover and recovery testing.
